services.name: Student Rush
services.desc: We’re excited to welcome schools to the Lafon Arts Center for our School Matinee programs - one of the region’s most engaging live theatre experiences for students. This year, we’re especially proud to share that we are expanding our student matinee offerings, opening the door for even more schools across the region to take part. While we’ve long served St. Charles Parish Public Schools, we’re now growing this program so more students can experience the impact of live performance. Our student matinees are built around performances that connect directly to classroom learning, while still feeling exciting, accessible, and alive for young audiences.
